rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 3AA label, but it leans heavily on the lab grade and includes image-specific claims (e.g., exact ICM location, top-tier certainty, thinning zona as visible) that may not be fully verifiable from a single image.

Integrates most relevant factors well, including age, tubal factor, ovarian response, prior IVF failure, smoking, sperm parameters, and endometrium, though BMI and some nuances around reserve interpretation are underdeveloped.

Reasoning is mostly logical and internally consistent, with a plausible probability range tied to embryo quality and modifiers; minor issues include overstating AMH as diminished reserve and inferring sperm DNA integrity from blastulation.
Mostly aligned on SET and general prognosis, but assisted hatching is not routinely recommended in this scenario, and PGT-A at age 34 after one failed cycle is more optional than guideline-driven.

Provides clear practical steps such as proceeding with SET, smoking cessation counseling, review of prior cycle, and future testing considerations, though some recommendations are somewhat speculative rather than tightly case-indicated.
